sn55.4:1.2: sāyanhasamayaṁ paṭisallānā → sāyaṇhasamayaṁ paṭisallāṇā (sya-all) | sāriputtaṁ → sārīputtaṁ (sya-all) | sāyanhasamayaṁ → sāyaṇhasamayaṁ (pts) | sāriputtaṁ etadavoca katinaṁ → sāriputtam etad avoca katīnam (pts) | la → S1-3 have yenāyasmā Sāriputto- -nisīdi. (pts note)
sn55.4:1.3: katinaṁ → katinnaṁ (bj) | sāriputta → sārīputta (sya-all) | sambodhiparāyaṇāti → sambodhiparāyanāti (sya-all, pts) | Katīnam → S1 katinaṁ S3 katinnaṁ. (pts note)
sn55.4:2.7: sambodhiparāyaṇāti catutthaṁ → sambodhiparāyanāti (sya-all, pts) | āvuso → S1-3 bhikkhave. 3 This second Sāriputta is the first in the Singhalese MSS. and the fourth of the chapter. (pts note)
